audit_report.root_cause_claim_text: Best Buy's gross profit in 2023 was $9,912 million
audit_report.rationale: The extractor reported gross profit of $9,912M for 2023, but this should be $27,912M (revenue $64,298M minus cost of sales $36,386M). This $18B error cascaded through the analyst's gross margin calculation (15.41% instead of ~43.4%), leading to an incorrect conclusion that margins are inconsistent when they are actually relatively stable (~22-23% in 2021-2022, with only 2023 affected by the extraction error).
